qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact six-byte, two-instruction RAX-based memory BT-to-JAE block at the measured fixture RIP with RCX as its bit index. The same block at an adjacent RIP declines.
admission.matcherHardening: The older measured RDX/R15 memory-BT matcher now also requires its exact ten-byte, two-instruction, one-statement address shape.
admission.transactionality: The signed bit-string path performs one restartable qword read, publishes only CF after success, and feeds the terminal not-carry branch without changing memory.
admission.deferred: Every other RCX-indexed or unmeasured memory BT remains interpreter-owned.

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,453 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indexes 0, 64, and -1 and both selected-bit states match the interpreter exactly in architectural state, memory, carry, and JAE target; the older RDX matrix covers 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65 plus failed-read rollback.
verification.negativeCoverage: The identical RCX block at the adjacent RIP declines.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different compilation, interrupt, cache, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed and counter differences are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.
